Chapter 478: Chapter 16: The Battle of Ascension (Please Subscribe)_2

“The youngster from Open Heaven.”

Enshrouded in mist, the figure furrowed his brows, “Let’s take action, don’t let them really advance up here…”

…

“Brother Open Heaven’s Power of Open Heaven must have broken through again…” the Supreme Immortal King muttered softly as he watched the axe lights cleaved by the Open Heaven Immortal King.

The other Supreme Immortal Kings agreed upon hearing this.

At this moment, the strength of the Open Heaven Immortal King was terrifying, every axe light was stronger than a full strike from a normal Supreme Immortal King. Such endless cleaving, even the Supreme Immortal King, would not dare to intercept directly.

...

Whoosh.

Suddenly.

The entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

Several figures walked out.

Among them, a towering figure also held a giant axe, but this one was entirely blue, the axe light pervasive, directly blocking the offensive of the Open Heaven Immortal King.

“Lads, are you rolling down yourselves, or shall we knock you down?”

The leading figure spoke, his voice booming, echoing across the Seventh Layer of Heaven.

“It’s Lingxu Immortal King, this old undying…” The tone of the Supreme Immortal King carried a hint of fear.

Lingxu Immortal King possessed a higher-level Power of Creation and six ordinary Powers of Creation, and all these powers were cultivated to the Third Realm, his strength was terrifying to the extreme.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was sizing up Lingxu Immortal King with somewhat heated eyes.

The aura of the Power of Creation emanating from Lingxu Immortal King included three types that Lin Yuan had never encountered before, one of which was a higher-level Power of Creation.

“Let’s go.”

“Together.”

The Supreme Immortal King soared into the sky, and the other Supreme Immortal Kings followed suit.

Boom, boom, boom.

In an instant, dozens of Supreme Immortal Kings were engaged in combat.

Each Supreme Immortal King’s offensives impacted for thousands of miles, and if the battlefield had not been in the Nine Heavens but in the Three Thousand Realms.

The mere aftermath of these dozens of Supreme Immortal Kings’ battles would have been enough to destroy the Three Thousand Realms several times over.

Countless True Immortals and Half-Step Immortal Kings would pretty much die out completely.

But in the Nine Heavens, especially in the Seventh Layer of Heaven, these aftershocks did not cause much impact.

Or rather, the impacts that did occur, such as torn spaces, would quickly recover.

Lin Yuan followed at the back, taking the time to survey the battle situation.

Open Heaven Immortal King was entangled by a Supreme Immortal King who also comprehended the Power of Open Heaven; their fighting style was almost the same, a straightforward axe for axe, but the Power of Open Heaven involved between each axe strike caused even ordinary Supreme Immortal Kings to tremble.

And the Supreme Immortal King was battling two Supreme Immortal Kings together, wielding the Immeasurable Force with each strike massively overwhelming, even when fighting two, he was suppressing the opposition.

Lin Yuan just glanced around and felt someone watching him.

“It’s been a long time since I’ve taken action.”

“Young lad, as a senior, I allow you to strike first, otherwise, you might not get the chance later.” A slender man stood in the distance, smiling kindly at Lin Yuan.

“Allow me to strike first?” Lin Yuan pondered.

Considering how much effort to use, even though the strength of the Taiji Primordial Spirit was far less than the True Body.

But possessing the higher-level Power of Taiji, along with four other higher-level Powers of Creation and dozens of ordinary Powers of Creation.

Even though the dozens of other Powers of Creation were all at the First Realm.

Plus the enhancement of an Inner World spanning millions of miles.

Combined, Lin Yuan’s strength, he believed, was not inferior to a Supreme Immortal King who mastered the Third Realm of higher-level Power of Creation.

Perhaps even stronger.

“Yes…”

The slender Immortal King nodded slightly.

Suddenly.

His expression subtly changed.

Becuase he realized Lin Yuan had disappeared.

This disappearance was not movement or teleportation, but a true disappearance, vanishing from this world.

“Not good.”

The slender Immortal King’s expression drastically changed.

Instinctively, he began to retreat explosively.

But it was already too late, Lin Yuan’s figure, unbeknownst to him, had appeared by his side.

Then he gently threw a punch.

This punch had no might leaking out, but in the eyes of the slender Immortal King, it felt like his scalp was exploding, vaguely sensing a deadly threat.

“Split.”

The slender Immortal King’s skin burst forth with a lot of blood, the next moment his figure exploded.

Under Lin Yuan’s punch, his body was smashed to pieces.

Whoosh.

A phantom soul appeared.

Rushing towards the entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven frantically.

This soul moved so fast that even Lin Yuan felt unable to stop it, so he did not make a move.

“Pity…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The Power of Creation wielded by the slender Immortal King, he had already comprehended it, killing the opponent did not yield much benefit.

The explosion of the slender Immortal King’s body.

Immediately attracted the attention of other Supreme Immortal Kings around.

Those Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era looked at Lin Yuan with unbelievable eyes.

The strength of the slender Immortal King might not be very formidable, but it wasn’t too weak either; that he could be smashed so decisively by a single punch… could it be that he had comprehended some high-level Power of Creation to the Third Realm?

And was it a similar offensive Power of Creation like the Power of Open Heaven?

Only under such an unexpected situation, without the slender Immortal King’s prepared defenses, could he have been taken down so quickly.

“Hahaha, Martial Ancestor, I hadn’t expected you to possess such strength…” Open Heaven Immortal King laughed heartily, although the slender Immortal King did not perish, his physical body was shattered, and even if he could consolidate a physical body with his soul again,

his strength wouldn’t be fully displayed, and he certainly won’t participate in this ascendancy battle.

“Martial Ancestor?”

At the entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven, Lingxu Immortal King had not joined the battle, his task was to guard the entrance to prevent the Supreme Immortal Kings below from sneaking through and stealthily ascending to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.
